turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen's zero.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn and an apology, both in writing. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and her visit to the principal if she doesn't get them; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, which was never reached, and her time did not run out.
What moved her: Nothing, because you ended the meeting before putting anything in front of her.
What cost ground: Nothing, since no case was made for or against you before you stopped.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; nothing you said came near that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fights so hard.
Try next time: Open with one sentence owning that the zero went into the gradebook before you called her, then put a dated document in front of her.
The meeting is over. To practise again, start a new chat and paste the first message from the README.
